title: CodeChallenge: Train model 1 with GPT2's embeddings

cues.en: This will be the last time that we work with model one in this course.
cues.zh: 這是課程最後一次使用模型一。

cues.en: It's a nice model because it's super duper simple, but at some point it's just too simple to be really useful.
cues.zh: 它很好，因為極度簡單，但到某個程度，就簡單得不太有用了。

cues.en: Anyway, there are two concepts in this code challenge that I want you to learn.
cues.zh: 這個程式挑戰有兩個概念要學。

cues.en: First, how to copy weights from one layer of one model into the same layer in a different model.
cues.zh: 第一，如何把某個模型某層的權重，複製到另一模型的相同層。

cues.en: And second, how to freeze weights during training.
cues.zh: 第二，如何在訓練時凍結權重。

cues.en: Now, copying weights is obvious.
cues.zh: 複製權重的意思很明顯。

cues.en: What that means to freeze a parameter matrix during training means to prevent gradient descent from changing the weights.
cues.zh: 訓練時凍結參數矩陣，則是避免梯度下降改變那些權重。

cues.en: So the model still trains.
cues.zh: 模型仍然會訓練。

cues.en: You can still do gradient descent, but you can selectively block the optimization for a given layer that is called freezing that layer.
cues.zh: 仍能做梯度下降，但可以選擇性阻止某層最佳化，這就叫凍結該層。

cues.en: So we'll get back to that in a later exercise.
cues.zh: 之後練習會回來談。

cues.en: Let's begin with exercise one.
cues.zh: 先從練習一開始。

cues.en: This is really nothing new.
cues.zh: 其實沒什麼新東西。

cues.en: It's literally nothing new.
cues.zh: 真的完全沒有。

cues.en: All you have to do is copy all the code from the previous video to create the data sets and model one.
cues.zh: 只要複製上一支影片的所有程式，建立資料集與模型一。

cues.en: The only change that you need to implement here is to set the embeddings dimensionality to 768.
cues.zh: 唯一要改的，是把嵌入維度設為 768。

cues.en: That corresponds to the dimensionality of GPT two.
cues.zh: 對應 GPT-2 的維度。

cues.en: And you will know why we need to do that in exercise two.
cues.zh: 練習二就會知道為什麼。

cues.en: At this point, you should pause the video and switch to code and copy paste.
cues.zh: 現在請暫停，切到程式碼、複製貼上。

cues.en: Make that one change.
cues.zh: 做這一項修改。

cues.en: I am not even going to switch to code here, because there's literally nothing to show that you haven't seen before.
cues.zh: 這裡甚至不切到程式碼，因為沒有任何你沒看過的東西。

cues.en: Now for exercise two, import the pretrained GPT two model and copy the embeddings matrix from GPT two
cues.zh: 練習二，匯入預訓練 GPT-2，把嵌入矩陣從 GPT-2 複製到

cues.en: to GPT one.
cues.zh: 模型一。

cues.en: You can print out the sizes of the matrices to make sure that the sizes match.
cues.zh: 印出矩陣大小，確認相符。

cues.en: And when you have successfully copied the weights matrix from GPT to into model one, you should find
cues.zh: 成功從 GPT-2 複製權重矩陣到模型一後，應該發現

cues.en: that the embeddings from model one versus the pre-trained GPT two embeddings are identical.
cues.zh: 模型一的嵌入，與預訓練 GPT-2 的嵌入完全相同。

cues.en: There are several ways that you can demonstrate this identity.
cues.zh: 有幾種方法能確認。

cues.en: What I did here was subtract the two matrices from the two different models and find that their differences are all zeros.
cues.zh: 我把兩個不同模型的矩陣相減，發現差值全為零。

cues.en: So good luck with this exercise.
cues.zh: 祝你順利。

cues.en: It's not too difficult, but will help you build the skill of picking apart different layers of a model.
cues.zh: 不太難，但有助培養拆解模型不同層的能力。

cues.en: All right, this one I will discuss my solution for.
cues.zh: 這個練習會討論解法。

cues.en: Okay so here I have I'm importing the GPT two model.
cues.zh: 這裡匯入 GPT-2 模型。

cues.en: I call that model variable GPT two.
cues.zh: 模型變數叫 GPT2。

cues.en: And then here I'm creating an instance of model one.
cues.zh: 這裡建立模型一實例。

cues.en: So my model From earlier.
cues.zh: 也就是之前自己的模型。

cues.en: Okay, so now here I'm just checking that the sizes of the embeddings dimensions match, or the size of the embeddings matrices match.
cues.zh: 先檢查嵌入維度，或者說嵌入矩陣大小是否相符。

cues.en: That is obviously a first step before actually copying the weights over.
cues.zh: 顯然，實際複製權重之前，應先做這一步。

cues.en: So we find that both in model one and in GPT two, the embeddings matrix is 50,000 by 768 okay.
cues.zh: 模型一與 GPT-2 的嵌入矩陣，都是 50,000 × 768。

cues.en: So now copying the weights over super duper simple.
cues.zh: 接著複製權重非常簡單。

cues.en: Just make sure that you are accessing weight data.
cues.zh: 確保存取的是 weight.data。

cues.en: And the reason for that is let me comment this out.
cues.zh: 為什麼？先把這行註解掉。

cues.en: So if you just look at weight this is the information that you want.
cues.zh: 如果只看 weight，這就是想要的資訊。

cues.en: This is the parameter but it has a lot of additional overhead other than just the numbers.
cues.zh: 這是參數，但除了數字，還有很多額外資訊。

cues.en: Some of that overhead you see here requiresgrad equals true.
cues.zh: 例如這裡的 requires_grad=True。

cues.en: So there's just yeah gradient and other information that is, uh, inside this, uh, model embedding dot weight.
cues.zh: model.embedding.weight 裡，有梯度等其他資訊。

cues.en: And what we want is the data from those weights.
cues.zh: 但我們想要的是權重的資料。

cues.en: And now you can see all that additional information has been stripped away.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，額外資訊都拿掉了。

cues.en: And this is literally just the numbers okay.
cues.zh: 就只是數字。

cues.en: So we replace that from our model from model one with the corresponding matrix from GPT two okay.
cues.zh: 因此用 GPT-2 的對應矩陣，替換模型一的矩陣。

cues.en: And if that really works then we should find that when we subtract them we get zero if they really are equal.
cues.zh: 如果成功，而且兩者確實相等，相減應得到零。

cues.en: So what am I doing here.
cues.zh: 這裡做什麼？

cues.en: I'm just taking the first vector.
cues.zh: 只取第一個向量。

cues.en: So this is just the first token embeddings vector from our model and the GPT two model.
cues.zh: 也就是我們模型與 GPT-2 的第一個詞元嵌入向量。

cues.en: So this is not the entire embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 不是整個嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: But you know we can pick uh, you know, any one of them.
cues.zh: 但可以隨意挑任何一個。

cues.en: Now by the way, when I do this, then we certainly do expect that these numbers are different.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，如果這樣做，當然預期數字不同。

cues.en: These are completely different tokens.
cues.zh: 因為它們是完全不同的詞元。

cues.en: But for any matched token we expect the difference to be all zeros.
cues.zh: 但對任何相同詞元，都預期差值全零。

cues.en: Now for exercise three.
cues.zh: 接著練習三。

cues.en: Most of this exercise is copying code from the previous code challenge to train the model.
cues.zh: 大部分只要從上一個挑戰，複製訓練模型的程式。

cues.en: The only difference is that you want to freeze the embeddings matrix before training.
cues.zh: 唯一差別，是訓練前凍結嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: Now to be clear, we are not training GPT two that's already trained.
cues.zh: 說清楚，不是在訓練 GPT-2，那已經訓練好了。

cues.en: Instead, you are training model one, but you are not going to train the embeddings matrix in model
cues.zh: 而是訓練模型一，但不訓練模型一的嵌入

cues.en: one, because those embeddings values were copied from GPT two and then frozen.
cues.zh: 矩陣，因為數值從 GPT-2 複製而來，並已凍結。

cues.en: So you can make a plot of the train and test loss that you show over here.
cues.zh: 畫出這裡的訓練與測試損失。

cues.en: And when you're finished with exercise three, I recommend taking a screenshot of your plot, your results
cues.zh: 完成後，建議把練習三的圖、結果截圖，

cues.en: here, and store it somewhere because you will be interested in comparing this result from exercise three to the result from exercise four.
cues.zh: 存起來，因為之後會想和練習四比較。

cues.en: Okay, I hope you enjoy working through this exercise and now I will show my solution.
cues.zh: 希望你享受練習，現在展示解法。

cues.en: So here we are in exercise three.
cues.zh: 這裡是練習三。

cues.en: We are working on exercise three.
cues.zh: 正在做練習三。

cues.en: So I'm going to set the toggle to this.
cues.zh: 所以把這個開關設成這樣。

cues.en: This is exercise three variable to be true.
cues.zh: 把「這是練習三」的變數設為 True。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So if that's true then we can.
cues.zh: 如果為 True，就能，

cues.en: So here I'm just printing out the state of required grad.
cues.zh: 先印出 requires_grad 的狀態。

cues.en: And then I'm setting it to be false.
cues.zh: 再設為 False。

cues.en: And then I'm printing it out again.
cues.zh: 然後重新印出。

cues.en: And what does this do.
cues.zh: 這樣做什麼？

cues.en: So requires grad equals true.
cues.zh: requires_grad=True，

cues.en: This means that this weight matrix will be updated during optimization.
cues.zh: 代表這個權重矩陣會在最佳化時更新。

cues.en: But if you set it to be false then it means that this matrix of weights, this parameter is not going
cues.zh: 但設為 False，就代表這個權重矩陣、參數，

cues.en: to be modified during training.
cues.zh: 訓練時不會修改。

cues.en: So we set this to be false.
cues.zh: 所以設為 False。

cues.en: And that means that all of the parameters in the model, except for the ones in this matrix, are going to be trained.
cues.zh: 代表除了這個矩陣以外，模型其餘參數都會訓練。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And from there.
cues.zh: 接著，

cues.zh: 對。

cues.zh: 訓練和上一支影片完全相同。

cues.zh: 所有程式都直接複製貼上。

cues.en: I didn't change anything in this code cell.
cues.zh: 這個儲存格完全沒改。

cues.en: All I did was add this code here.
cues.zh: 只加了這段。

cues.en: And it's really just about this.
cues.zh: 真正重點就是這個。

cues.en: This is the key line here for exercise three.
cues.zh: 這是練習三的關鍵一行。

cues.en: And finally for exercise four.
cues.zh: 最後練習四。

cues.en: Now this is the same thing as exercise three.
cues.zh: 和練習三相同。

cues.en: Except here you want to allow the embeddings in model one to still be trained.
cues.zh: 但這次讓模型一的嵌入，仍然可以訓練。

cues.en: Now to be clear the embeddings in model one are still copied from GPT two.
cues.zh: 說清楚，模型一的嵌入仍是從 GPT-2 複製。

cues.en: So you're not training a completely random set of embeddings wakes, but the GPT two weights can be
cues.zh: 所以不是訓練完全隨機的嵌入權重，而是讓 GPT-2 權重

cues.en: trained instead of being frozen, and then you can have both of the losses plots next to each other from exercise three and from exercise four.

cues.zh: 現在就能視覺比較。

cues.zh: 這是我的結果。

cues.zh: 這些是截圖，虛線只是手動，

cues.zh: 我手動加上去，方便視覺比較。

cues.en: So basically the frozen model did worse in that the losses were higher.
cues.zh: 基本上，凍結的模型表現較差，損失較高。

cues.en: I wonder if you were surprised by this finding.
cues.zh: 不知道這是否令人意外。

cues.en: The thing is that freezing copied model weights and retraining is a common procedure in deep learning, especially for computer vision models like in CNNs.
cues.zh: 複製模型權重、凍結，再重新訓練，是深度學習常見程序，尤其電腦視覺，例如 CNN。

cues.en: It's especially popular when your data set is small and the models are big.
cues.zh: 資料集小、模型大時，尤其常見。

cues.en: Now, that said, it is not trivial that freezing weights is a good thing if the model isn't so complex,
cues.zh: 但凍結權重不一定有好處；如果模型沒那麼複雜，

cues.en: and if you have a lot of data, especially if the data are different from the initial training data,
cues.zh: 資料很多，尤其資料和最初的訓練資料不同，

cues.en: then freezing can actually prevent the model from learning important characteristics of your data.
cues.zh: 凍結反而可能阻止模型學習你的資料的重要特性。

cues.en: And in fact, model one here actually tends to learn a little bit better without the GPT weights mapped on.
cues.zh: 其實這裡模型一，不套用 GPT 權重，往往還學得稍好一些。
